== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Commander Praji (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]] (<code>1210_4</code>, Virtual Block 1 slip 04), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-04-Commander_Praji.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-D-commanderpraji-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Commander Praji (V) (Virtual Block 1)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons: the pilot icon (“Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots”) and the ▲ arrow (“take … into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”) are drawn as on the printed slip.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Once during your control phase (twice if on Devastator) may use 1 Force to take any Imperial pilot of ability < 3 into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker), STANDARD rev 71: the card's own Virtual Legacy card (same Decipher art, frame, lore, icons, slip number and Virtual Block 1 set mark as the printed card) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
